title: Magnetic lignin-supported sulfonic acid ionic liquid: a novel catalyst for synthesis of 2-amino-4-aryl-4H-benzo[f]chromen-3-carbonitrile derivatives
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,46380-46390
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07067H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Majidreza Gerami, Mahnaz Farahi, Bahador Karami
A novel Brønsted acidic ionic liquid immobilized on modified magnetic lignin (Fe3O4/MPL–[IL]) was successfully synthesized and comprehensively characterized by FT-IR, XRD, EDX, VSM, FE-SEM, TGA, and TEM analyses.
